segments: The main NixOS configuration files are located in /etc/nixos/:
config: the configuration state of the entire system
...: allows additional arguments to be passed in, ignoring those not used
UEFI/systemd-boot and BIOS/GRUB are two examples; choose the one matching your installation mode. Verify GRUB's whole-disk target rather than blindly copying /dev/sda.

The static addresses below use a documentation-only address range, not a usable real network. Replace them with values for your network. When using desktop NetworkManager or static interface configuration, make clear which one manages a given interface.

The docker group has elevated privileges; join it only when genuinely necessary. Before disabling SSH password authentication, verify that key-based login works so you do not lock yourself out of administrative access.

build only builds; dry-build only shows the build plan; test activates immediately; switch activates immediately and makes the result the boot default. None of these alone proves that services actually work correctly.
